name: Human Skeletal System
summary: This scene illustrates the human skeletal system, the body's internal framework. Composed of 206 bones, the skeleton provides crucial structural support, protects vital internal organs, and facilitates movement through articulation with muscles. It is broadly categorized into the axial skeleton, which forms the central axis of the body, and the appendicular skeleton, which includes the limbs and their attachments.

objects.label: Human Skeleton
objects.description: The complete framework of 206 bones that gives the human body its form. It is divided into the axial skeleton (skull, spine, ribs) which protects the core organs, and the appendicular skeleton (limbs and girdles) which facilitates movement.
